reviews.title: Overall bad
reviews.text: If I could give a 0 stars I would!!! I have been trying to contact customer support since day one. Have not gotten one email back, not even an acknowledgement they received my email and someone will get back to me. App glitches when inputting food data, had to pay $49.99 for a useless app that I can’t even use and when requesting refund or cancellation within the first week of having the app….no response! App shuts down in the middle of entering food then have to start all over again and I don’t have time for that. This is supposed to make it quick and easy to track food. Truly disappointed and still have not received a response from customer support.
